title: [Dev] Timestamps are showing as HH:mm PM/AM 12 hour format instead of 24 hour format in english
symptom: In the Dev version, timestamps are showing in 12-hour format with AM/PM instead of 24-hour format, while in Master 3.3 they are 24-hour. The issue is observed in English locale.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but a maintainer reverted a change that likely caused the issue.
fix: The maintainer reverted the change that caused the issue, as indicated by the commit link.
